title: User-facing changelog from seeded release notes
objective: Measure whether the changelog-writeup craftbook filters internal noise, buckets user-facing changes, and calls out breaking changes.
prompt: In the `Changelog Writeup Eval` project, read `source/merged-changes.md` and write `CHANGELOG.md` for version 2.4.0 dated 2026-06-27. Include user-facing Added, Changed, Fixed, and Security buckets as appropriate, exclude internal-only noise, and put the breaking API change in a prominent migration note.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for the changelog-writeup craftbook. Source changes are in workspace/source/merged-changes.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce a plain-language Keep a Changelog style CHANGELOG.md from seeded merged changes, excluding internal noise and highlighting breaking changes.

files.content:
# Merged Changes Since 2.3.0

- PR #418 Added CSV export for filtered inventory reports.
- PR #421 Changed webhook payload field `customerId` to `customer_id`; breaking for existing integrations.
- PR #424 Fixed duplicate shipment status emails when labels were regenerated.
- PR #425 Security: tightened SAML certificate expiry validation.
- PR #426 Internal: refactored reducer names; no user-facing change.
- PR #427 CI: upgraded lint runner.

success.summary: CHANGELOG.md has version/date, buckets, user-facing entries, breaking migration note, and excludes internal noise.

axes.name: de-noising
axes.description: Internal-only, CI and lint changes are left out, and every user-facing change is in.

axes.name: bucketing
axes.description: Each entry sits in the right Added, Changed, Fixed or Security bucket and is written for the people who use the product.

axes.name: migration note
axes.description: The breaking API change is prominent and says exactly what a caller must change.
